conclusion: The highest mean five-fold ROC-AUC among seven operational candidates was Revised | Logit (0.758, SE 0.006); its paired descriptive gain over raw operational Logit was +0.008. The single held-out audit gave ROC-AUC 0.741 and AP 0.327. At the fixed 2/3 threshold it predicted 2 buyers and assigned 2,464/2,466 vouchers; training OOF similarly predicted 6 buyers and assigned 9,858/9,864 vouchers. Thus ranking is moderate while the precommitted policy has very little selectivity. Test hypothetical Rq/A spans 472.2–1971.2 across assumed q values, a difference of 1499.0; q is unobserved and these are not causal effects, measured growth or profit. No formal calibration assessment was performed. Pure nominal levels leave Logit boundary-MLE uncertainty; NB conditional-independence and Gaussian distribution assumptions remain limitations, while LDA may be strained by mixed and long-tailed features. Duplicate rows do not identify unique visitors, PageValues timing is unverified, prior overlapping-sample exposure limits historical independence, and training-based candidate selection adds optimism. Original course source labs/lectures were unavailable for direct comparison.
